title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts — Early Release of an Accepted Batch in Drop Disputes
content:
Releasing an accepted batch quickly gives it the best chance of being re-offered in time. Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, dropped-batch dispute credits are weighted by how soon the batch was released.

**Rule.** The forfeited-offer credit, the reliability credit and the drop praise credit are added, and that sum is then adjusted by how soon the batch was released, counted in calendar days from the day it was accepted to the day it was dropped: a batch released on the day it was accepted has the sum doubled; a batch released on the next day has it increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point; a batch released two or more days after acceptance has it used as it stands.

Both dates come from the dropped batch's record in Cartwise Shopper Batches: its acceptance time, taken as a calendar day, and its drop date.

## Condition — adjustment

| Calendar days from acceptance to drop | Sum of the three credits |
|---|---|
| 0 (same day) | Doubled |
| 1 (next day) | Increased by half of itself, the half rounded up |
| 2 or more | Used as it stands |

## Worked sums (hypothetical)

| Sum | Same day | Next day | Two or more days later |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 point | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| 3 points | 6 | 5 | 3 |
| 5 points | 10 | 8 | 5 |

A batch accepted at 22:50 on 9 July and dropped at 00:20 on 10 July was released on the next calendar day: a sum of 3 points becomes 3 plus 2 (half of 3 rounded up), 5 points.
